inventory.note: The candidates array contains contribution candidates only; the complete classified inventory is in source-map.md.

candidates.purpose: Convert arbitrary text to a deterministic uppercase ASCII JavaScript identifier for IIFE globals.

mazeyComparison.notes: Mazey 5.1.0 provides the exact behavior and the local duplicate has been removed.

generalizationRequired: Rename to state uppercase global-name semantics.
Document that Unicode and punctuation become underscores.
risks: The output is an identifier only and must not be treated as authorization for dynamic evaluation.
Changing ASCII or case policy later would be breaking.

candidates.purpose: Parse common GitHub repository shorthands and transport URLs into canonical identity fields.
sideEffects: Throws for malformed or unsupported input.

mazeyComparison.notes: Mazey 5.1.0 provides the strict parser; the local wrapper retains npm metadata extraction and package-specific errors.

generalizationRequired: Move npm repository-object extraction to the caller.
Reject or explicitly define credentials, query strings, fragments, and percent encoding.
Use generic error messages independent of package.json.
testCases: scoped npm package context does not affect parsing
risks: Canonical parsing is not repository authorization.
Overly permissive shorthand grammar can accept unintended text.

candidates.purpose: Detect standard standalone display mode and the iOS Safari navigator.standalone fallback.

mazeyComparison.notes: Mazey 5.1.0 provides the guarded global API; the project retains an injected adapter for deterministic tests.

generalizationRequired: Guard missing browser globals and missing matchMedia.
Keep injected host objects internal to tests rather than the ordinary public signature.
risks: Standalone display does not prove installation, service-worker control, or origin trust.
Browser vendors may add display modes that need separate policy.

candidates.purpose: Derive package build identity from package metadata.
sideEffects: Throws when package name is missing.

mazeyComparison.notes: No composite equivalent; parts are native, project policy, or separate candidates.

generalizationRequired: Keep package validation and install-command policy local.
Use native package basename extraction.
Replace incomplete author normalization with a specified parser or no abstraction.
Extract global-name generation independently.
risks: A broad packageDetails API would freeze project-specific release policy into Mazey.
Current author-string behavior is incomplete.

candidates.purpose: Create a deterministic cryptographic content fingerprint from named byte sequences.
candidates.proposedSignature: function fingerprintFiles(files: Iterable<{ name: string; contents: Uint8Array | string }>, options?: FingerprintOptions): string
sideEffects: Current implementation reads a directory synchronously.

mazeyComparison.notes: Mazey genHashCode is a small non-cryptographic string hash and is not equivalent.

generalizationRequired: Remove directory walking and project exclusion rules.
Define ordering and duplicate logical-name behavior.
Define whether caller-provided logical names normalize path separators.
Make algorithm and output length explicit.
risks: A truncated digest is a cache key, not a signature.
Duplicate logical names or caller-provided separator aliases require an explicit policy.

candidates.purpose: Read width and height from a PNG IHDR header without decoding image pixels.
candidates.proposedSignature: function readPngDimensions(data: Uint8Array): { width: number; height: number }
dependencies: node:fs and Buffer in the current implementation
sideEffects: Current implementation reads a file synchronously.
generalizationRequired: Accept bytes rather than a file path.
Use DataView or specified byte reads instead of Buffer-only methods.
Define whether the API validates only a complete IHDR header or the full PNG structure and CRCs.
Define whether dimensions above the PNG specification limit should be rejected by this helper.
risks: Header dimensions do not prove that the complete PNG is valid or safe to decode.
Unbounded dimensions should not be used for allocation without limits.

candidates.purpose: Validate local HTML fragment links within a bounded output tree.
dependencies: node:fs and node:path in the current implementation
a real HTML parser would be required

mazeyComparison.notes: No Mazey link or fragment validator exists.

generalizationRequired: Parse HTML instead of using regex attribute/id extraction.
Separate document loading from validation.
Return structured issues.
Define query, percent-decoding, symlink, case-sensitivity, and directory-index rules.
risks: Filesystem containment is incomplete without explicit symlink policy.
HTML parser behavior must match deployment semantics.

candidates.purpose: Return structured validation issues for a documented subset of web app manifest metadata.
candidates.proposedSignature: function validateWebAppManifestMetadata(value: unknown, options?: ManifestValidationOptions): ManifestIssue[]

mazeyComparison.notes: Mazey isSafePWAEnv only checks runtime prerequisites and does not validate manifest data.

generalizationRequired: Preserve safe unknown-input handling.
Define the standards subset and configurable required fields.
Return field/code/message issues instead of project prose.
Support valid CSS colors or explicitly document a six-digit-hex policy.
risks: A partial validator can imply standards compliance it does not provide.
The manifest specification evolves and requires maintenance.

candidates.purpose: Determine whether the current context is eligible for service-worker registration under optional scope policy.
candidates.proposedSignature: function isSafePWAEnv(options?: { requireManifest?: boolean; scope?: string }): boolean

mazeyComparison.notes: Mazey 5.1.0 now supports requireManifest and scope options; the local predicate retains project enablement and injected environment policy.

generalizationRequired: Keep project enabled flag in the caller.
Use secure-context semantics consistently rather than duplicating protocol/localhost rules.
Define normalized scope matching and encoded path behavior.
Preserve default isSafePWAEnv behavior for compatibility.
risks: Changing current isSafePWAEnv defaults would be breaking.
Eligibility does not guarantee successful registration.

candidates.purpose: Resolve a decoded relative path only when it remains inside an allowed root.
candidates.proposedSignature: function resolvePathWithinRoot(root: string, value: string, options?: PathContainmentOptions): string | null
sideEffects: Current implementation performs existence and stat checks.

mazeyComparison.notes: Mazey has no Node filesystem containment helper.

generalizationRequired: Separate URL parsing, base-path policy, filesystem existence, and directory-index resolution.
Define realpath and symlink containment.
Reject encoded separators and null bytes consistently.
Cover Windows drive, UNC, and case-insensitive path behavior.
risks: Lexical path containment alone does not prevent symlink escape.
Platform-specific normalization can create security gaps.
